rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.FlagErrorf/MutuallyExclusive, git.WithRepoDir, and pr/shared conventions; but the requested reusable helper lives in pr/shared rather than on git.Client, and a local runGitCommands loop mirrors checkout's executeCmds.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles blank path, --worktree without --checkout, --list conflict, relative-to-absolute, spaces as single arg, existing vs new branch, worktree reuse, symlink/non-dir targets; ff-only pull scoped to worktree with warning on failure.
rationale.scope: Core feature delivered, but git-client helper not added as specified, flag doc omits the --checkout constraint, and pr/checkout was refactored beyond need (localBranchExists replaced everywhere, helpers removed).
rationale.readability: Clear flow and names; some 'why' doc comments (symlink rationale, revParseFacts) were dropped when moving code, and checkout unwraps then re-wraps WorktreeTarget awkwardly.
rationale.robustness: Worktree target validated before any API mutation; filepath.Abs and git errors propagated; no panics; pull failure degrades to warning like existing flow.
rationale.maintainability: Both commands share resolve/command-building logic; minor duplication (runGitCommands vs executeCmds) and passing both opts.Worktree and target.Path into checkoutBranch is redundant coupling.
